text: This staff report is about a matter for which the Toronto and East York Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. This is a report on the refusal to issue a permit by Municipal Licensing and Standards in the matter of an application for a boulevard café permit located at 1485 Dupont Street, Unit 100, Campbell Avenue flankage.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the boulevard café licence (patio) application for 1485 Dupont Street (flankage) on the condition that the applicant submits a petition with majority resident support for the patio to the satisfaction of the Ward Councillor. The petition is to be submitted no later than July 23, 2018 and the area to be canvassed for support by the applicant should be the same area that was previously officially polled by the City Clerks office for this patio application.
